marta: Heads-up — we need a coordinated rebuild of ubuntu-base:22.04 droplet image after an upstream chain of CVEs surfaced in the libc++/crypto stack. Planning RBAC/KMS/audit impacts + runtime hardening. TL;DR: cosign attestation, rotate KMS signer, tighten bake runner perms.

devon: Can you drop the vuln triage link and list affected images?

marta: Link: https://go/internal/vuln/2026-xyz (internal). Affected: ubuntu-base:22.04, runtime-minimal:sha256:abc123..., sidecar-logging:sha256:efg456. Also a couple of EU-hosted customer images referencing the old base.

sam: For RBAC — propose creating dedicated GSA `image-baker@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` with minimal perms (push/sign only). Avoid using broad CI runners.

li: KMS note: current key is `projects/dev-keys/locations/global/keyRings/image/cryptoKeys/signer`. Rotation scheduled 2026-04-03. Need to confirm cosign + our pipeline accept new key version(s) (cosign supports `kms://` URIs). Also ensure Data Access logs are on.

security-bot: automated-scan: found 4 additional HIGH deps in runtime-minimal. Run `trivy image --severity HIGH` in pipeline. I also queued a quick SBOM diff.

devon: How do we roll this out with minimal user impact for Dedicated customers? Can we dual-sign old + new and keep old tags for a window?

marta: Yes — rollout plan (high level):
1) Build minimalized images (remove unused packages)
2) Cosign-sign with new KMS key (support dual-sign for verification backward-compat)
3) Push to staging registry and run canary fleet in eu-west and us-west
4) Monitor audit logs + runtime errors for 48h
5) Promote tags and schedule old-key revocation after successful window

oncall: @oncall I can cover a canary window tomorrow. Need 2h coverage for monitoring?

oncall: I can cover 09:30–11:30 UTC. Ping 15m before the start.

sam: RBAC checklist snippet: 
```
- Create GSA: image-baker@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com
- Grant scoped `roles/storage.objectAdmin` to staging bucket only
- Grant `roles/cloudkms.signerVerifier` scoped to signer key for cosign
- No owner/editor privileges on bake pipeline
```

li: Audit log checks: 
- Ensure `requestMetadata.callerIp` present in logs for external pushes
- Export admin & data access logs to `sec-log-bucket` (365d retention)
- Add log-based metric `cosign_verify_failures` to alert on > 1/min

marta: Runtime hardening items: switch to userns remap, drop CAP_NET_RAW from runtime pods, and enable seccomp/profile baseline. This will probably break a few internal debug containers — we'll validate in staging.

devon: Can we gate deploys on cosign verification? Block if `cosign verify` fails?

sam: Yes — add `cosign verify --key ksm://projects/.../locations/.../keyRings/.../cryptoKeys/...` as a hard gate in CI.

marta: :thumbsup: I'll open the PR for build pipeline + cosign steps and add reviewers @sam @li @devon. Action items: build PR, RBAC change, KMS rotation prep, runbook for oncall/SOC.

li: I'll draft a runbook snippet for SOC/oncall: rollback steps (re-pull old tag), how to re-sign with fallback key, and contact list for key-owner.

security-bot: Recommend scheduling a small playbook drill `image-rebuild-drill-v2` once staging passes. Use #release-war-room for live comms and ops page.

devon: Sounds good. I'll coordinate the dedicated-customer communication (pre-cutover notice + fallback window). Thanks all.
